row_before_A_to_F: Bill To: Where the locked Bill To tooltip appears

In the design, the tooltip of a locked Bill To appears under the customer card starting at the very left edge of the browser window (over the asset card), and the deposit tooltip is one long line at the bottom left. Is that the intended place?
(a) Yes, as drawn.
(b) Next to the Bill To value, wrapped to a normal tooltip width.
(c) Something else (please say).
The spec says only that the message is the field's tooltip. The "Pays for" tooltip also appears under the card.
Spec: Story 5 (SV-12307), the tooltip rules. The design "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), page 3, pictures "Hover" (invoiced and deposit); page 1, "Tooltip".
